The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. Scope of Work: The vendor shall carry out complete engine overhauling, repair, reconditioning, machini ng, replacement of defective parts, testing, and commissioning of the JCB 3DX Super engine as per the ma nufacturer's specifications. 2. Genuine Spare Parts: All spare parts shall be genuine JCB parts or OEM parts meeting the manufacturer' s specifications. Duplicate, counterfeit, or substandard parts shall not be used. 3. Warranty: The vendor shall provide a comprehensive warranty of 12 months (one year) from the date of successful completion and acceptance of the overhauling by the buyer. 4. Vendor's Responsibility: During the warranty period, the vendor shall be fully responsible for engine-rela ted defects, breakdowns, or failures arising from faulty workmanship, improper machining, or defective sp are parts supplied or fitted by the vendor. 5. Free Rectification: All warranty-covered defects shall be rectified by the vendor free of cost, including sp are parts, labour, machining, dismantling, refitting, and other associated expenses. 6. Vendor's Workshop: The complete overhauling shall be carried out at the vendor's workshop, which mus t have the necessary tools, equipment, and skilled manpower. 7. Transportation and Safety: The vendor shall be responsible for the safe transportation of the engine/mac hine between the buyer's premises and the vendor's workshop, wherever included in the scope of work, an d for its safe custody while in the vendor's possession. 8. Testing and Commissioning: After overhauling, the engine shall be thoroughly tested and commissioned to ensure satisfactory performance before delivery and acceptance by the buyer. 9. Delivery and Acceptance: The overhauled engine/machine shall be delivered to the buyer's premises in fully serviceable condition within the stipulated period. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory ins pection and testing by the buyer. 10. Warranty Service at Buyer's Premises: If any warranty-covered engine defect occurs during the warran ty period, the vendor shall arrange inspection and rectification at the buyer's premises, wherever feasible, or arrange transportation to the workshop and back at no additional cost to the buyer. .
